answer: The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, held in escrow until finality, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. By the lantern of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. The atlas holds work receipts rather than names, so the cedar of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
